sentences.text: On 01.03.2023 at about 10.00 a.m., the victim girl had returned to her house.

On enquiry,
she had informed the complainant that the petitioner NC: 2023:KHC:45977 had proposed to her and on 27.02.2023, she had gone with him in a car to Dharmastala and thereafter, they had gone to Kukkesubramanya and stayed in a lodge.
Subsequently, they had returned to Nelamangala and stayed in Vajreshwari lodge, Nelamangala and thereafter, she had returned home.
The victim girl had stated that when she stayed in the lodge with the petitioner they had sexual intercourse.

Though the complainant was informed by the petitioner's mother on the night of 27.02.2023 itself, that the petitioner and the minor victim girl were at Dharmastala, no complaint was lodged till 01.03.2023.
It is only after the victim girl returned home, the complaint was lodged.

4. On perusal of the complaint as well as charge sheet material, it is seen that the petitioner and the victim girl were in love and the victim girl had accompanied him to Dharmastala, Kukkesubramanya and thereafter to Nelamangala and they had stayed together in the lodge.
The petitioner is a youngster aged about 19 years and he is in custody from 02.03.2023.
Investigation is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
The allegation against the petitioner is required to be proved during full-fledged trial before the Court.
Continued NC: 2023:KHC:45977 detention of the petitioner who is aged about 19 years will have serious impact on his career and future prospects.
Hence, I am of the opinion that the petitioner has made out a prima facie case for grant of regular bail.

Accordingly,
I pass the following:
ORDER
The Criminal Petition is allowed.
